reading.title: The Modern House on the Corner
reading.intro_zh: 这篇短文不复述姐姐从 Nigeria 回来的原文，而是换成一个新故事：姑姑多年前去了国外，她离开前街角就 had begun 盖一座大胆的新房子，她走得太早没看到样子；房子大约一年后 was completed。她来信说 would come 回来探亲，If she comes 一定会大吃一惊。家人说她可以 stay with us。这座房子非常 modern，在一片旧砖房的 district 里显得 strange，对姑姑来说它 must be 整条街最大的变化。重点练习 had begun、was completed、would come、If she comes、stay with us、district 和 must be。
passage: My aunt grew up on our old street, but she moved abroad years ago. Before she packed her bags, builders had begun work on a bold new house on the empty corner, though she left too soon to see what it would become. The house was completed about a year later. It has wide glass walls, a flat roof, and a quiet courtyard. She wrote to us last week and said that she would come back to visit this autumn. If she comes, she will not believe her eyes. My parents say she can stay with us during her trip. The building is so modern that it still looks strange in our district of old brick homes. To my aunt, it must be the biggest change on the whole street.

questions.question: Who is going to return to the old street this autumn?
options: A young architect from another city.
The narrator's aunt, who moved abroad years ago.
The narrator's parents.
A new family moving into the district.
questions.explanation_zh: 短文说 my aunt ... moved abroad years ago，并在信里 said that she would come back to visit this autumn。

questions.question: What had already begun before the aunt left?
options: A trip abroad for the whole family.
Repair work on the old brick homes.
Work on a bold new house on the empty corner.
A plan to open a small shop.
questions.explanation_zh: 文中写道 builders had begun work on a bold new house on the empty corner，而且发生在她 packed her bags 之前。

questions.question: When was the new house completed?
options: About a year after the aunt left.
Before the aunt moved abroad.
Last week, when her letter arrived.
This autumn, on the day she returns.
questions.explanation_zh: 短文说 work had begun before she left，而 The house was completed about a year later，所以是在她离开大约一年之后完工。

questions.question: Why will the aunt be surprised if she comes back?
options: Because her family has moved abroad as well.
Because the empty corner is exactly as she remembers it.
Because the old brick homes have all been knocked down.
Because a strikingly modern house now stands on the once-empty corner.
questions.explanation_zh: 她离开时街角还是空的，回来会看到一座非常 modern 的新房子，所以 If she comes, she will not believe her eyes。

questions.question: Why does the new house look strange in the district?
options: Because it is too small for one family.
Because the aunt does not like glass walls.
Because it is very modern and stands among old brick homes.
Because every other house nearby is modern too.
questions.explanation_zh: modern 在这里不是 bad，而是因为它和周围的 old brick homes 风格不同，所以在 district 里显得 strange。

writing.intro_zh: 今天抓五个 Lesson 23 的时间线句式：用 said that...would... 转述过去说的未来计划，用 If...will... 写真实可能，用 had begun before... 排出更早的过去，用 was completed...ago 写被动完成时间，再用 must be the only... 表达强烈判断。

patterns.title: said that she would ...
patterns.source: In her letter, she said that she would come to England next year.
patterns.focus_zh: 用 said that...would... 转述别人过去说过的未来计划，适合写信、消息或转告。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：某人在信、消息或电话里说，他/她明年、下周或假期会回来、参观或入住。
patterns.sample: In his message, he said that he would visit our new classroom next week.
patterns.tip_zh: said 是过去说，would 把当时说的“将来会做”放进转述里。

patterns.title: If she comes, she will ...
patterns.source: If she comes, she will get a surprise.
patterns.focus_zh: If...will... 写真实可能发生的未来：如果前面的条件发生，后面就会有结果。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：如果一个亲戚、朋友或同学回来，他/她会看到一个惊喜或变化。
patterns.sample: If my cousin comes home this winter, she will see our new kitchen.
patterns.tip_zh: If 后面常用现在时 comes，主句用 will；不要写 If she will comes。

patterns.title: had begun before ...
patterns.source: Work on it had begun before my sister left.
patterns.focus_zh: had begun before... 用来说明一件事在另一个过去动作之前已经开始。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：某个装修、建设、训练或准备工作在某人离开、到达或发现之前已经开始。
patterns.sample: Work on the new library had begun before we left for the holiday.
patterns.tip_zh: had begun 是更早的过去；before 后面接另一个过去动作，时间线就清楚了。

patterns.title: was completed ... ago
patterns.source: The house was completed five months ago.
patterns.focus_zh: was completed 把重点放在“东西被完成”，后面加 ... ago 说明完成时间。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：某个房间、花园、教室或项目在几天、几周或几个月前完工。
patterns.sample: The new reading room was completed three months ago.
patterns.tip_zh: was completed 是被动语态；不需要说明是谁完成的，重点是 finished result。

patterns.title: must be the only ...
patterns.source: It must be the only modern house in the district.
patterns.focus_zh: must be the only... 表示很有把握的判断：它很可能是唯一一个。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：一个现代房间、建筑、商店或教室在老街区、学校或小区里很可能是唯一的。
patterns.sample: It must be the only modern cafe in the old district.
patterns.tip_zh: must be 不是命令，而是强烈推测；the only 后面接名词，说明它很特别。
